tei:div.tei:p: "$ (255)༄༅// ni gu lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil chog bzhugs so//

(256)༄༅// na mo gu ru// sangs rgyas rdo rje bde ba che// khrag 'thung dpal gyi dkyil 'khor ni// ye shes lnga ldan la btud nas// dkyil 'khor cho ga bri bar bya// 'dir ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i man ngag /lugs 'di'i khrid tshul kun gyi sngon du 'gro ba/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang gi cho ga ni rnam pa gnyis te ras bris la brten pa dang*/ rdul mtshon la brten pa'o// de la dang po'i dbang du byas nas lhag gnas dang dngos gzhi dang rjes kyi bya ba gsum las/ dang po la sngon 'gro gtor ma sum+bha sa bsang*/ sā bhā wa sa sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes byin gyis brlab/ phaiṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya staṃ/ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ sa mgron rnams bkug / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsi un mā da a pa sma ra ḍā kā ḍā ki n+yā da yaḥ/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu ya thai baṃ ya thaiṣ+ṭaṃ bhuñdza tha dzi gh+ra tha pi pa tha mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sat+su khaṃ bi shud dha ye/ sa hā yi kā bha wan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas// klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang*// gnod sbyin (257)tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang*// 'byung po'i tshogs= sha za'i tshogs= smyo byed tshogs= /rjed byed tshogs= ma mo'i tshogs rnams= de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs// ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dam can khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi// las la srung ba dam pa dang*// yul phyog 'di dang sbyin bdag dang*// slob ma la yang shis par mdzod// gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba'i// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams gang yin pa// gtor ma'i lhag ma 'di longs la// da lta nyid du gzhan du dengs// ci ste 'gro bar mi byed na/

rdo rje 'dzin chen khros pa'i bkas// mtshon cha 'bar ba'i sprin spros nas// lus sems rdul du brlag ta re// zhes gtor ma phyir dor la mtshams bcad/ de nas mchod pa gcig bshams la/ gnas dang yo byad bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang du hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du chud pa'i bh+rūṃ las gnas khang gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ (258)oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams las byung zhing lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bzang zhing gya nom pa/ yul dus chad pa med par yongs su khyab cing*/ rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab par rang bzhin bde stong gi ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung byed las rang gzhan mtha' dag zag med kyi bde bas tshims par byed pas phyi nang thams cad du gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai bi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥ o badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ rol mos byin 'bebs zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ghāṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsā li te/ prañdzā pā ra mi tā nā da sam+bha wa te badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.āḥkhaṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas bdag bskyed ni skyabs 'gro nas dkyil 'khor nyer bsdu'i gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar yan chad sgrub thabs bzhin tu bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir mchod pa rgya cher bsham/ gtor ma gnyis kyang bshams te slar yang gong bzhin mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ rol mo byin 'bebs mi dgos/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu dus gsum gyis sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs thams cad gcig tu 'dus te/

mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa ni/ skad cig gis phyi rol dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ sna tshogs rdo rje la gnas pa'i gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog /ces pa nas/ 'khod par gyur/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba ltar mchod bstod gtor bsngo rnams bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i (259)sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis sang nyin dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub stsol ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la rgyas pa la dga' na phyis kyi lag len ltar/ bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa mchog /rigs sngags rgyal po khyod la 'dud// slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo// de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la// bka' drin gnang bar mdzad par rigs// sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya phyir stsol// byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*// gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha// lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*// 'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang*// sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba// gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams// bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol// bdag ni rdo rje che ge can// bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor ni// ji ltar nus pa nyer sbyor bas// 'gro ba sbyong phyir bri bar bya// de phyir bdag dang slob ma la// rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas// dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni// nye bar 'byon par mdzad par rigs//

zhes pas kyang lan gsum gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum/ gang yang bdag blo sogs bzod par gsol nas oṃ muḥ zhes dbyings su gshegs su gsol lha lhag par gnas pa'i don no// bum pa gnyis spyi dang mthun par bshams bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir zhing*/ mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyangs pa lha'i gos kyi mgul bcings dang dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su (260)paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa zhes pa nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las rang nyid ces sogs kyi tshig dor ro// de nas bum bzlas ni yab yum gyi nye snying dang mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags rnams ci 'grub tu bzla/ a bhi ṣe ka ta 'i sngags kyang nyer gcig la sogs pas byin gyis brlab/ bum pa'i mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs byas la/ ār+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ yab yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas la oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ bum nang gi lha rjes chags kyi mes yongs su zhu ste byang chub kyi sems su gyur// zhes brjod/ ci ste las bum logs su sgrub pa 'dod na snga ma'i bzlas pa song mtshams su las bum gyi nang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa skad cig gis bskyed nas sum+bha'i sngags ci nus su bzla/ mchod pa man chad phyogs gcig tu mdzad mchod yon dang gzungs thag phyogs so sor byed pa'am snga phyir spo ba'i srol kyang yod/ 'on kyang 'di la las bum gzhung las ma bshad cing nges par dgos pa'ang ma yin no// bum pa lhag gnas so// slob ma rnams la sngon 'gro'i bya ba rnams skabs 'dir byed pa slob ma lhag gnas kyi don yin cing lhag por bya ba ni sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa 'bul ba yin no// de yang 'di ltar sngon 'gro rnams pa bcu'i nang gi gsang ba bsgrag pa dang ye shes dbab pa nangs par dgos pas skabs 'dir mi mdzad/

bsam pa 'chos pa dang*/ skyabs sems dang*/ spro ba skyed pa dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa'i gsol ba btab pa dang*/ gnang ba sbyin pa dang*/ rtog pa bsdu ba dang*/ yan lag lnga pa dang*/ sdom pa 'bogs pa rnams song ba'i rjes su nang mchod dang dri bzang bsres pa'i thig les slob ma'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum brjod de byin gyis brlabs la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad sku rdo rje rnam snang gi rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams dpral bar thim/ gsung rdo rje 'od dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs te mgrin par thim/ thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i rnam par spyan drangs te snying gar thim par mos mdzod/ ces bya/ 'di sngon 'gro dgu pa byed cing bcu pa ni gzings bstod pa ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams/ zhes pa nas des kyang 'di la dga' bar gyis zhes pa'i bar ro// (261) de ltar na 'dor len gyi dbang du byas pa'i sngon 'gro rnam pa bcu po de dag ni slob ma lhag gnas so// dgu pa dang bcu pa'i bar du so shing khyor chu srung skud ku sha rnams steng ba'i lag len 'ga' zhig la snang ba spyir mi 'gal yang gzhung na med pas nges par dgos pa ma yin no// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la dkyil 'khor sgrub pa/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ bdag nyid 'jug pa/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gnas yo byad byin rlabs bdag bskyed nyer bsdu'i bar gong lhag gnas kyi skabs bzhin du bya/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ mchod pa bzang po dang gtor ma zlum gtor gnyis sam thod gzugs dang tshon sna lngas brgyan pa gang rung bya/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi dbus su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/

baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ suṃ las ri rgyal lhun po shar shel/ byang gser/ nub pad+ma rā ga lho bai ḍūr+ya las grub pa bang rim bzhi dang ldan zhing lcogs brgyad kyis brgyan pa gru bzhi pa ste 'byung bzhi ri rab rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa'o// de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūm̐ las 'byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser lte ba mthing nag gru bzhi pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ srung 'khor rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re mda'i drwa ba me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas par gyur/ srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du bh+rūṃ las gzhal med khang chen po gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang pha gu dang drwa phyed dang rin po che dang mda' yab la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang rnga yab la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lha dang mi las khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchod pa'i sprin du mas gang ba/ nang ka ba (262)brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang de'i steng du rdo rje'i thal gdung gnyis mig mang ris su bres shing mdzes par phubs pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis nye bar brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad dang de dag tu gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba brgyad dang*/ zhing skyong ba brgyad dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung dang*/ sprin dang*/ ri dang*/ mchod rten rnams brgyad brgyad dang bcas pa/ 'byung po dang srin po dang sha za dang ro langs dang mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams rgyu ba/ ro dang keng rus dang bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs pas yongs su gang ba'o// gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar byang ljang nub dmar lho ser dbus sngo ba'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang ge sar du bcas pa dang pad+ma'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'o// de'i steng du rang nyid gnas par gyur/

bdag nyid hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa las rang nyid dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga in+d+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum g.yo ba/ khro zhing sgeg la chags pa'i nyams can mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ bzhin shin tu 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer bsdus shing 'jigs su rung ba/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor rus pa'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i nor bu dang ral pa'i ngos la sna tshogs rdo rje dang g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pas brgyan pa/ mi rus kyi rna cha dang mgul rgyan dang gdu bu'i tshogs dang ska rags dang mchod phyir thogs kyis brgyan pa/ thal ba chen pos nye bar byugs shing mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dpa' bo'i dar dbyangs dang bcas pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i khrag 'dzag mgo bo lnga bcu'i do shal can stag (263)gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po dang g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo mnan pa gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o// de la 'khyud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis phyogs thams cad gnon cing g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu skra grol zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas yab la 'khyud pa/ yab yum gnyis ka yang lang tsho gsar du bdo ba me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// thugs ka nas maṃ tāṃ pāṃ lāṃ rnams spros te phyogs bzhir 'khod/ bh+rūṃ oṃḥdz+riṃ khaṃ bzhi spros te mtshams bzhir 'khod pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las shar gyi 'dab ma la mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan dbang gi lha thams cad kyang dkyil 'khor ba la gnyis su med par thim/

bar 'dir lha so so'i snying po ci 'grub tu bzlas pa'i mthar lha drug po re re'i sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka tā+e no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+ya me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shri yeḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ sbyar ba lan gsum gsum gyis brtan par bya'o// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ bde mchog sgyu 'phrul 'khor lo'i rol pa las// yan lag brgyad ldan rdo rje ar+ghaṃ'i rgyun// kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshor rab spel bas// mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i 'khor lor sdom gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ pra (264)tīts+tsha hūm̐ swā hā/

de'i tshigs rkang gnyis par/ zhabs kyi pad+ma'i gdung sel rdo rje'i chu// zhes dang ar+ghaṃ kyi tshab tu pā d+yaṃ sbyar te chu gnyis so// oṃ bzang zhing dge ba'i me tog ni// gtsang zhing gtsang ma'i gnas las skyes// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gi// rdo rje nyi ma pad+mar phyung*// me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa// rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid mchog /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐// dri yis rgyas pa lha yi rdzas// nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di// bdag gis sogs tshigs rkang gnyis gong bzhin/ rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min cing*// lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis// nges par bsregs pa de yi spros// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ dhū pe// srin po 'joms zhing gtsang byed pa// mun pa sel byed dge ba 'di// bdag gis sogs/ yi ge hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal// mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ dī paṃ/ gtsang dag skye gnas las skyes pa// dge ba'i dri bzang dam pa 'di// bdag gis sogs/ bde ba chen po'i nam mkhar gnas// byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*// de nyid kyis kyang byugs pa ni// thugs kyi/ gan+dhe/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas mchog 'di dag /bdag gis sogs/ 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod// dbang po thams cad yang dag brtan// de dag thams cad thugs rdo rjer// bza' ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya/ nai wi d+ya/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sems byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /rdo rje pad+ma yang dag sbyar// zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung*// rnal 'byor ba yi gzhom med sgra// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐/

ghāṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs dang rol (265) chen bya/ mchod pa rgyas par spro na gos zung bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi na bza' bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ kha dog bzang zhing dri zhim reg na bde// srab 'jam yang mdzes lha las byung ba yi// na bza' mchog 'di rdo rje'i sku la 'bul// bgres pa med pa rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra was+t+ra ya āḥhūm̐/ rang gi snying ga nas a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥzhes pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug nam mkha' gang bar spros/ oṃ bī ṇe badz+ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin tu waṃ she/ mṛ daṃ ge /mu ra dze/ hā s+ye/ lā s+ye/ gī ti/ nṛ d+ye/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ rū pa/ ra sa/ spar+she/ dhar+m+ma dhā tu badz+rī huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa zhes pa tsam mam/ de las rgyas par spro na nam mkha' gang bar spros/ zhes pa'i mtshams su/ rdo rje lha mo pi wang brdung*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog sngo// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// oṃ badz+ra bī ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ des 'gres te/ rdo rje lha mo gling bu 'bud// rkang pa gsum par/ rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog ser/ waṃ she/ rdo rje lha mo rnga chen brdung*// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog dmar/ mṛ daṃ ge/ rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga brdung*/ rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog ljang*/ mu ra dze/ bzhad pa rdo rje lha mo ni// dmar skya phyag gnyis bzhad dang bcas// mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes par rol/ hā s+ye/ sgeg pa rdo rje lha mo ni// sngon mo phyag gnyis sgeg dang bcas// rkang pa phyi ma gnyis sngar ltar sbyar te/ lā s+ye/ glu yi rdo rje lha mo ni// ser mo ting ting shags dang bcas/ gī ti/

gar gyi rdo rje lha mo ni/ ljang gu phyag gnyis gar dang bcas/ nri t+ye/ mdog dkar rdo rje me tog ni// g.yas na me tog cang te'u dang*// g.yon pas thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /mchog (266)rnams rdo rje dbyings mnyes mdzod/ puṣ+pe/ mdog mthing rdo rje bdug spos ni// g.yas na bdug spos cang te'u dang*// tshig phyi ma gnyis sbyar zhing*/ dhū pe/ mdog dmar rdo rje mar me ni// g.yas na mar me cang te'u dang*/ dī pe/ mdog ljang rdo rje dri chab ni// g.yas na dri chab cang te'u dang*/ gan+dhe/ gzugs kyi rdo rje me long bsnams// dkar mo g.yas mtha' cang te'u dang*// g.yon pas thod pa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ rū pa badz+rī/ ro yi rdo rje 'khar gzhong bsnams// dmar mo sogs gong bzhin te// ra sa badz+rī/ reg gi rdo rje na bza' bsnams// ljang gu sogs/ spar+she badz+rī/ chos dbyings rdo rje chos 'byung bsnams// dkar mo sogs/ dhar+m+ma dhā tu badz+rī/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun chad nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dzi te āḥhūm̐// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la// nor bu rin= dbul zhing phongs pa rgyun chad nas// 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi rat+na/ btsun mo rin chen= ma rig mun pa rgyun chad nas// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs te// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog was+t+rī/ blon po rin= phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma hā ta/ glang po/ lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal zhing*// bla med theg pa rab zhon nas// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ha sti/ rta mchog= /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol nas// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob ste// sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod par shog

/tu raṅga a shwa/ dmag dpon rin= nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyis rgol ba tshar bcad de// bsnyengs bral mchog ni thob par shog khaḍ+ga/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// (267)phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul na// bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra sa pā ri wa ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi ta āḥhūm̐// phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin dang*// yon tan tshig brjod sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /shab+da/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sprul snying dang*// a gar la sogs dbang po tshims byed rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= /gan+dhe/ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos= bzhes shig= ra sa/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshims byed rnams// mos blos= /bzhes shig= spar+she/ bsdu na gong gi chu gnyis nyer spyod dang rig ma bcu drug tshigs bcad dor bas mchod nas 'dir 'jug /nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlab/ khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*// rdo rje btsun mo dpal gyi ni gu ma// mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor la// rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rmog lcogs mnyam med rin chen brtson 'grus dang*// dbon ston spyan ras gzigs dbang skyer sgang pa// thog rdugs grub chen gnyan ston ri gong par/ rnam dag= 'gro ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas ston pa dang*// gtsang ma shangs ston tshul khrims 'bum pa'i zhabs// khyung po gsum par byon pa'i tshul mgon la// rnam dag= /bya bral ri khrod dbang phyug ras chen dang*// mkhyen ldan shangs pa dkar po rin rgyal ba// mnyam med chen po sangs rgyas dpal bzang la// rnam=

/grub chen chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang*// rgya sgom sbas pa'i rnal 'byor legs rgyal ba// 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dam pa'i sder// rnam dag= /(268)'chi med dbang po mchog gzigs lha dbang grags// mkhas mchog byang chub thugs mnga' rdo ring dbon// bde mchog bla ma'i skur ston sgrol mgon zhabs// rnam dag= /mtha' yas ye shes rgya mtsho rgyal tshab mchog /yon tan rmad byung 'gro ba'i mgon po rje// zag med lus can mgon po dpal 'byor la/ rnam dag= /lam zab bdud rtsis rab myos mgon po grags// grub rigs gtsug rgyan mgon po rnam par rgyal// rdo rje'i rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i sder// rnam dag= /rtsod bral nā ro'i sgyu 'phrul 'brug pa rje// bstan pa'i snang byed dge legs dpal 'bar ba// brgyud srol nor bu'i phreng 'dzin kun dga'i mtshan// rnam= /nyams rtogs mthar phyin bka' brgyud bstan 'dzin dang*// dbon ston sgyu 'phrul karma lhag mthong zhabs// rmog lcogs dngos byon gzhan phan 'od zer can// rje btsun rin po che phyin chad kyi kha skong gu ṇas bgyis pa'o// brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// rnam dag= /'khor lo bde mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// mkha' 'gro lā ma khaṇ+ḍa ro he dang*// gzugs can ma sogs dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// rnam dag= /myur mdzad spyan ras gzigs mgon re ma tī// k+ṣe tra pā la dzi na mi tra dang*// ṭā k+ki rā dza bdud mgon trak+shad la// rnam dag= /phyogs bdag zhing skyong klu yi dbang po dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dur khrod gnas pa'i tshogs// gnyug mar gnas pa'i gzhi bdag ma lus la// rnam dag= oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ// 'di ni thog ma dbus mtha' med// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid//

ces bstod cing mnyam par bzhag /de nas bstod pa ni/ oṃ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang phyug chen po ni// bskal pa chen po'i me dang mnyam pa'i 'od// ral pa gyen du brdzes pa'i (269)cod pan can// mche ba gtsigs pa drag po 'jigs pa'i zhal// gzi brjid ldan pa stong phrag phyag gis ni// dgra s+t+wa zhags gdengs mdung dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bsnams shing stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'dzin// dud kha mun nag chen po'i sku la 'dud// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpā gi san+ni bhā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā mu ku ṭot+ka ṭā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ daṃṣ+ṭ-i ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ par shu pā shod+ya ta shū la kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dhā ri ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā gh+ra dzi nām+bang da dhā rā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrān+dha ka ra ba pu ṣā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi rkang brgyad dang*/ oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo 'phags ma ni// gzhan gyis mi thub 'jig rten gsum yum rig ma ni// dbang phyug 'byung po'i 'jigs pa kun sel rdo rje che// rdo rje'i gdan ma mi pham dbang mdzad gzhan mi rgyal// spyan 'phrul dug skem drag mo khro mo mche gtsigs ma// skrag byed gsod byed 'joms byed rnam rgyal gzhan las rgyal// rmugs byed rmongs byed rengs byed rdo rje phag mo ni// rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang mo mkha' 'gror 'dud// huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra bā rā hi baṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na ma ā r+yā pa rā dzi te trai lo kya mā te ma hā bid+ye shwa ri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na maḥsarba bhū ta bha yā ba he ma hā badz+re huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+rā sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba sh+yaṃ ka ri ne tra bh+rā ma ṇe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ na maḥsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dhe ka rā li ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo s+t+rā sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa rā dza ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo bi dza ye dzam+bha ni/ stam+bha ni mo ha ni huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā rā hi ma hā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri kha ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ gzhan yang*/ ye shes lnga ldan ngo bo nyid// rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po ste// sangs rgyas kun 'dus he ru ka /bde mchog dpa' bo la phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas rigs kyi dkyil 'khor kun// mnyam (270)nyid gcig tu bsdus pa'i sku// mkha' khams shes rab pha rol phyin// rdo rje phag mo la= /rdo rje rigs kyi dkyil 'khor kun// gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid// chu khams rnam dag snying rje'i dngos// mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// las kyi rigs= gcig tu= /rlung khams rnam dag btang snyoms dngos// lā ma'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// pad+ma'i rigs= /me khams rnam dag dga' ba'i dngos// dum skyes ma la phyag 'tshal 'dud// rin chen= /gcig tu= /sa khams rnam dag byams pa'i dngos// gzugs can ma la= bde gshegs rnams kyis byin brlabs pa// gzungs ma rnams kyi= /bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa dang*// pad+ma'i snod la= /thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang*// byang chub phyogs kyis rnam par brgyan// lha rnams bzhugs pa'i gdan dang bcas// rtag pa'i rang bzhin khyed la= /rnam shes brgyad po rnam dag pa// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i tshul// 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi gnas// dur khrod brgyad la= /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yis// bdud tshogs ma lus zil gnon pa// mi phyed srung ba'i 'khor lo la// rtag tu gus pas= /chos nyid shes rab gru gsum gnas// ye shes lnga tshogs lam lngas brgyan// dkyil 'khor ma lus sprul ba'i gzhi// bde chen de la= /de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba yis// rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba rnam dang nas// rnam lnga ye shes go 'phang ni// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mthus thob shog

/ ces pas kyang bstod/ mchod bstod de tsam ni nges par bya dgos la rgyas par spro na mchod pa'i rnam grangs ji snyed yod pa kun gzhan nas kha skong ste 'dir sbyar bas rung la 'di ni yig rnying du gtogs pa'i mchod pa du ma rgyas la nyog pa rnams kyi spros pa spangs te yid brtan thub nges pa rnams bsdus te bkod pa yin no// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni phal cher sgrub thabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las ye shes lha la gtor ma 'bul ba'i rjes thog de nyid la gtor chog ltar myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po la gtor ma 'bul// de rjes oṃ kha kha sogs kyis 'byung po'i tshogs la gtor ma sbyin no// gsum pa ni/ (271) sngon 'gro dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chan khyod bdag ston pa ste// sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de nas rgyun bshags ni/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang gang*// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas su// ma lus de dag bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi// sgom dang bzlas brjod bsod nams kyi// tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sems bskyed mngon par sangs rgyas nas// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi mchog /de la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// sangs rgyas 'byung ba ji lta bar// skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' yis// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du sangs rgyas shog /'gro la phan phyir chos rnams ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol//

zhes lan gsum/ de nas sdom bzung ni/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ ji tsam dus nas bzung nas su// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas su// nam zhig byang chub snying po la// yongs su gnas kyi bar dag tu// bdag gis byang chub mchog gi sems// ma lus par ni bskyed par bgyi// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// nam du yang ni mi spang ngo*// (272)rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol*// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum/

ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ lan gnyis kyis mig dar dang me tog blang*// nyungs dkar gtor zhing sum+bha 'i sngags kyi bgegs bskrad/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag ste oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bsrung bar bya/ rang gi snying khar he nag po rgyu dang bral ba/ mgrin par ru dmar po tshogs dang bral ba/ dpral bar ka dkar po gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ lte bar shrī ser po gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gyur/ shrī he ru ko3 haṃ/ zhes stong pa nyid du sems bskyed/ de nas ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes yol pa'i nang du bcug / oṃ na ma ste hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes phyag 'tshal du gzhug /de nas gsang ba bsgrags pa ni gnas gsum du dri bzang gis thig le byas la/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ /thugs kar hūm̐/ snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa oṃ sarba yo gi tsit+taṃ ut+pa da yā mi/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas dam la (273) bzhag pa ni rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// khyod kyi spyi bor bzhag pa yis// sangs rgyas sku ru khyod 'grub cing*// mi phyed ye shes thob par 'gyur// snying gar bzhag la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// bdud rtsi lnga'i nang mchod blug la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badz+ra sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka hūm̐/ yang rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyi// rdo rje 'dzin pa nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bka' stsal pa// gus pa'i tshul gyis nyan par gyis// gal te nga la brnyas pa na// sangs rgyas thams cad brnyas pa yin// mi bde ma spangs dus byas nas// dmyal ba chen por 'gyur ta re/

bcu pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyis// byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes mchog /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gtso bos bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i skur gsal ba'i rkang mthil gnyis kyi 'og tu yi ge dzhaiḥdamar po skul bar byed pa po/ gsang bar āḥdamar po gsung rdo rje/ snying gar hūm̐ nag po thugs rdo rje/ spyi bor haṃ dkar po sku rdo rje/ snying gi nang du 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum tshon gang ba rnams 'khod par gyur/ slob dpon nam mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gsung sku rdo rje rnams 'od zer mthing dmar dkar gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs gnas gsum gyi hūm̐ āḥhaṃ rnams la thim/ dzhaiḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs lus nang gi yi ge gsum bskul bas de rnams kyi 'od zer gyis lus gyi nang thams cad gang zhing lus sems (274)thams cad bde bas khyab/ yang slob dpon nam mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros te sangs rgyas thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs rang gi snying gar sib sib thim par gyur// spos dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te yi ge bdun pa mang du bzlas shing oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā we sha ya hūm̐ zhes bzlas pas ye shes dbab/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra lan gnyis kyis brtan par byas la oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog dor/ stobs dang ldan pa'i sems can khyod// 'di ni so sor bzung bar bgyi// zhes me tog spyi bor bcings/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed pa ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣuḥhūm̐ āḥ

de ni phyi'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa yin no// dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros rang gi lus la phog 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal nas zhugs rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa yab rkyang gi rnam par gyur/ yang sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres te rdo rje'i lam nas byung ba'i thig le'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas rang gi phung khams skye mched thams cad rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo gdod nas grub pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur// hūm̐ zhes bya bas gsang ba nas phyir spros te phyi'i gzhal yas khang gi shar sgo'i nang du pad nyi la 'khod par gyur/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i skabs yin na de nas skabs 'dir rten dang brten pa bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag sgrub thabs dang mdun bskyed kyi skabs bzhin lha ngo bstan par bya la/ bdag 'jug gi skabs ni phyi dkyil mthong bar mos pa tsam gyis chog go /de nas rang bzhin gyis ni dag pa'i bdag /lus ni rang bzhin dri ma med// dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang mo'i gnas// dkyil 'khor la ni bu khyod ltos// zhes nang gi dkyil 'khor blta bar bskul/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med kyi (275)sku la gnas pa'i rtsa rnams mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ khams rnams dpa' bo'i rang bzhin du nges par gyis shig / de ni nang gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i tha snyad mdzad do// dngos gzhi las rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'phul/ bsam gyis mi khyab chos kyi snod// bdag la dbang ni bskur du gsol// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs/ de la dang por chu dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/

rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum ma mā ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te phyi rol du dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/ byang chub kyi sems kyi cha gcig ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa de nyid thogs te dbang bskur// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ gtso bo yab yum gyi nye snying dang lha mo bzhi'i sngags kyi mthar oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur lus thams cad bde bas gang snying ga'i 'khor lo brtan par byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ de ltar chu dbang thob pas rnam par shes pa'i phung po rnam par dag ste me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas so// zhes dang cod pan gyi dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ (276)bdag dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan gnyis ka slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig āṃḥlas rin po che āṃḥgis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing rus pa'i rgyun gyis brgyan par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te phyi rol du dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/ byang chub kyi sems kyi cha gcig dbu rgyan du gyur/ lha rnams kyis dbu rgyan de nyid thogs te dbang bskur/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi shiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te staṃ a haṃ zhes dbu rgyan bcing*// slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur la/ oṃ rat+na sam+bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur lus thams cad bde bas gang lte ba'i 'khor lo brtan par byas chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ de ltar cod pan gyi dbang thob pas tshor ba'i phung po rnam par dag ste mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas so// rdo rje'i dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka slob dpon gyi zhal du gcug thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig dz+riṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te phyi rol du dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/ byang chub kyi sems kyi cha gcig rdo rjer gyur// (277)lha rnams kyis rdo rje de nyid thogs te dbang bskur bar gyur/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐// sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab sgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs//

slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur la/ oṃ pad+ma dha ra a bhi shiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur lus thams cad bde bas gang mgrin pa'i 'khor lo brtan par byas chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ de ltar rdo rje'i dbang thob pas 'du shes kyi phung po rnam par dag ste so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas so// dril bu'i dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu gnyis ka slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres te rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te phyir rol du dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/ byang chub kyi sems kyi cha gcig dril bur gyur/ lha rnams kyis dril bu de nyid thogs te dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya/ zhes dril bu gtad/ slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur la/ oṃ karma bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur lus thams cad bde bas gang gsang ba'i 'khor lo brtan par byas chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa lam don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ de ltar dril bu'i dbang thob pas 'du byed kyi phung po rnam par dag ste bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas so// ming gi dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bu gnyis ka slob (278)dpon gyi zhal du bcug thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/

rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te phyi rol du dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/ byang chub kyi sems kyi cha gcig rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bur gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i dril bu de nyid thogs te dbang bskur/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal gsang ba'i ming btags/ slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur la/ oṃ bud+dha bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur lus thams cad bde bas gang spyi bo'i 'khor lo brtan par byas chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ de ltar ming gi dbang thob pas gzugs kyi phung po rnam par dag ste chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas so// de ltar dbang rnam pa lnga po de thob pas phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga/ khams lnga yum lnga/ dbang po dang yul rnams sems dpa' dang sems ma/ rnam par dag pa'i lus kyi cha rnams khro bo dang khro mo'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa yin no//

de nas sngags kyi dbang ni/ bdag nyid 'khor lo bde mchog yab rkyang gi rnam pa can du gyur/ snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/ rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs snying gar hūm̐ gi mtha' bskor du 'khod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba bud+dha sogs lan gsum gsum/ de nas me tog 'bul ster byed bzhin par/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ 'di la 'go (279)bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te phyi rol du dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/ byang chub kyi sems kyi cha gcig rdo rjer gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis rdo rje de nyid thogs te dbang bskur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra sa twa hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur la/

oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur lus thams cad bde bas gang gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo brtan par byas chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ de ltar rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi dbang thob pas ye shes kyi phung po rnam par dag ste lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byas so// spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi dbang ni/ bdag nyid hūm̐ las byung ba'i he ru ka 'khor lo sdom par gyur/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ḍā ma ru thod pa tshangs skud rnams gtad/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u lhung bzed sbyin// dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lha'i sku/ ḍā ma ru stong pa nyid kyi sgra/ thod pa (280)bde ba chen po/ tshangs pa'i skud pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngo bo nyid do// lung ston cing gzengs bstod pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po dang slob dpon dbyer ma mchis pa dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i skur gyur pas lung ston cing gzengs bstod par byung*/ 'di ltar ngas khyod lung ston yin// he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod bton// oṃ shrī he ru ka sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ bhūr+bhu baḥswaḥ gsang ba'i ming yid kyis dran par bya/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te// grong khyer mchog tu khyod zhugs so// de nas phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur gyi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'khor lo phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang*// dam pa bdag la stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang dbang rdzas dang po'i rdo rje dang dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu gnyis ka slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug thugs kar byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/

rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le cha gnyis su gyur pa'i cha gcig hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po he ru ka sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor bas g.yas brkyangs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes bya bas mkha' nang nas phyir spros te phyi rol du dbang stegs kyi gdan la 'khod/ byang chub kyi sems kyi cha gcig cha gnyis su gyur te dang po'i rdo rje dang dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bur gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis rdo rje de nyid thogs te dbang bskur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas// de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ rab tu sgrub phyir rdo rje longs// rdo rje gsor zhing snying gar gtad la/ (281)thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o// slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis dril bu de nyid thogs te dbang bskur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bar bzhed// lan gsum du dkrol te dku g.yon pa la brtan nas/ āḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// rang nyid skad cig gis dpal he ru ka phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa lo bcu drug lon pa lta bus yang dag par 'khyud pa/

yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod// gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan// de nas phyag rgyar rab tu bsgrag /shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod// slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ oṃ badz+rī bh+ra ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba chen po myong*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas// mi bya ba ni ci yang med// de nyid shes nas de nas ni// dpa' bo 'dod pa lnga spyod do// bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos// bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi gnas// de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya// bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchog /rten cing (282)'brel par 'byung chos can// sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin te// khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni// 'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med byos// ces pa ni rjes gnang ngo*/ de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs// bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas/ gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// ces lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum rjes chags kyis snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba'i sgras sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i bde ba'i rten kun+da lta bu dang rdul gyi dngas ma rdo rje dang pad+ma las mthe bong dang ming med kyis yang dag par blangs te rang gi lce thog tu bzhag

/'di de dpa' bo lha mo rnams// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga ldan pa'i ros rtogs byed// bde ba gang de byong bar byos// oṃ āḥhūm̐ a ho ma hā su khaṃ// 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// byang chub sems ni bzang po yis// de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems myang bas mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gang*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags/ bde ba'i ye shes brjod bral rgyud la skyes par gyur/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs// gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam gtum mo dang sgyu lus sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kyi// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pas// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin// mnga' (283)bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ lan gsum/ phyag rgya lo bcu gnyis nas nyi shu'i bar gang yang rung ba lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa bdag la gtad// lha mo 'di ni khyad par che// mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo// rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya langs// bu yis bla med mchod par gyis// lha mo des kyang*// gshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten pa la dga' 'am/ bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i gnas su tsum+ba na// khyod ni spro ba yin nam ci// zhes dris pa la// de la sogs pa'i dam tshig kun// lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// zhes lan btab pas de dgyes nas phyogs kyi gos can gsang rtsa rgyas pa'i pad+ma mtshon bzhin du e ma bdag gi pad+ma ni// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// ci ste cho ga bzhin brten na// sangs rgyas snyems ma la sogs pa// bya ba thams cad pad+mar byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/

pad+ma bhañdza hoḥ bdag dang rig ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum gyi skur rdzogs pa la hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje oṃ las skyes pa'i nor bu bu gar phaṭa kyis yongs su bkag pa/ hrīḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma āḥlas skyes pa'i ze'u 'bru rtse mo āḥs mtshan pa thabs shes snyom 'jug rjes su chags pa'i rkyen gyis byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ lte bar byon pas khyad dga'/ gsang bar byon pas g.yo med du brtan par byas pa ni lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba'o// slar yang gyen du gshegs par gyur te mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas don dam rang rig lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong zung 'jug mngon du byas/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ (284)lam gzhan lus shes rab sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas// dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bdag la bka' drin bskyab tu gsol// lan gsum/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs// rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid// khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do// sems nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ dmigs pa med pa'i sgyu lus dang lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zung 'jug tu gdod ma nas rang shar ba ni dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes te de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po sgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku rang bzhin lhun grub mngon du byas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtong rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/

deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags kyis// khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol// lan gsum/ dge ba bsngo'o// bdag 'jug rkyang pa la ni de tsam gyis chog la/ slob ma la dbang bskur na slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi// bde ba'i byin rlabs gang yin pa// bden pa de yis mgon dag la// khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyogs pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*// de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum gyis bden stobs brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag (285)gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis kyang gnang bar byin par bsam mo// bzhi pa ni/ gong du ji skad bshad pa'i bdag 'jug gi don de rnams slob ma la 'bogs pa yin te bdag 'jug gi tshig don legs par byang na lag len mthong ba tsam gyis shes par 'gyur bas logs su ma bris so// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bya ba rnams rdzogs pa na/ slar yang mchod pa gsar du bshams pa'am kha gso gong bzhin byin gyis brlab/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da 'i bar gyis phyi mchod phul/ snying po drug po'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la thugs brtse ba chen por mdzad de bar chad zhi ba dang dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/

ces pa dang gzhan yang 'dod don gsol ba ci rigs pa btab/ yig brgya mang du bzla/ bzod gsol gshegs gsol smon lam bkra shis bsngo ba rnams sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin byed dgos pa las mgron gshegs gsol gyi mthar dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs bya/ smon lam dang bkra shis sogs rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'dod pa bya'o// gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi phyogs la brten pa ni/ sa chog dang thig tshon byin gyis brlabs nas thig gdab cing dkyil 'khor zib dang rdul tshon gshegs su gsol ba la sogs pa dgos te rgyas pa la dga' na rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga chen mor bshad zin pa las shes par bya zhing*/ da lta lag len byed pa nyung bas 'dir ma bris la snying po bsdus pa'i yig chung zhig 'bri ba yang 'gyur ro// dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 'di la lha lhag gnas rgyas pa dang*/ ras bris kyi skabs sa'i lha mo'i cho ga ni mi dgos te 'di nyid kyi rang lugs gong du bshad pa kho nas 'grub par 'gyur ro// ni gu'i lugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga 'di la dkyil chog rgyas pa rgya gzhung ma gtogs bod yid dag gsal cha tshang ba zhig cher mi snang la/ cho ga'i yan lag 'ga' re bris 'dug na'ang shin tu nyog par mngon cing*/ rje phrol mchog gis mdzad pa 'di yang zhub po'i blo ngo dang bstun pa'i rang lugs las phyir phyogs pa mang du snang bas/ 'dir dag cing gsal la gzhan dang ma 'dres pa rang lugs ma tshang ba med cing bzung bde bar bkod pa yin no// rnal 'byor can la nyer mkho ba'i// dkyil chog sgros pa nyung du 'di// bshad las dge ba gang thob des// lhan cig skyes pa'i sa thob shog /ces pa'ang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/// /
